name: Grafana Labs
summary: Grafana Labs builds open-source and cloud observability software for monitoring metrics, logs, traces, and application performance.
overview: Grafana Labs develops the open-source Grafana visualization platform and Grafana Cloud, a managed observability service used to monitor infrastructure and applications. Its products bring together metrics, logs, traces, profiles, and incident-response workflows for engineering teams.

facts.label: Latest disclosed valuation
facts.note: Grafana Labs completed a $270M primary and secondary transaction that extended its Series D financing.

facts.label: Operating milestone
facts.note: Disclosed with a September 2025 secondary transaction.

bull_case: Open-source adoption creates a broad developer funnel, while Grafana Cloud can convert that usage into recurring enterprise revenue across a large observability market.
bear_case: Observability is crowded, and hyperscalers plus established vendors can bundle monitoring capabilities into broader cloud and software platforms.
latest_round: August 2024 primary and secondary transaction: over $6B valuation

intelligence.description: Open-source and cloud observability software for infrastructure, applications, and digital services.
company: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana, an open-source platform for visualizing and querying operational data. Its commercial products extend the ecosystem into managed observability, including monitoring for metrics, logs, traces, profiles, and incident response.

The company reported more than $400 million in annual recurring revenue and more than 7,000 customers in September 2025. It completed a secondary transaction that month, although the company did not disclose a new valuation or capital amount.
intelligence.why_it_matters: Observability sits close to the core infrastructure of modern software and AI deployments. Grafana Labs is a useful private-market benchmark for how open-source developer products can build enterprise-scale recurring revenue without relying solely on a proprietary software model.

takeaways: Open-source distribution gives Grafana Labs access to a broad developer audience.
The company reported more than $400M in ARR as of September 2025.

Competition includes specialist observability vendors and bundled cloud-platform products.
